name: Federal law of the Russian Federation (Constitution, federal constitutional laws, codes, federal laws)
label: Russia
record_note: 3045 acts from the state system "Законодательство России" (1 Constitution, 29 federal constitutional laws, 32 codes, 2983 federal laws), every edition it holds a text for, to the in-force date of 2026-10-25; data built 2026-10-29.

dates.commit: in-force (the date the system gives each edition: "на <date>")
dates.time: 12:00 Europe/Moscow (offset of the day, rules hard-coded)

author.amendment: the act the edition names (refadoption), or for an edition without text of its own, the act its history note or edition list points to
author.editorial: the publisher (editions that name no act)

scope.when_absent: not extracted for Russia yet; transitional provisions are in the amending act at the Source link

default_reach.rule: no retroactive effect unless the law says so; never for laws that establish or aggravate liability, or impose new taxes or worsen taxpayers' position
default_reach.meaning: a law applies to relations that arise after it enters into force; it applies to earlier relations only where the law expressly provides for it; a law that establishes or aggravates liability, or establishes new taxes or worsens the position of taxpayers, has no retroactive force
default_reach.authority: Constitution of the Russian Federation, articles 54 and 57; Civil Code of the Russian Federation, part one, article 4(1); Criminal Code, article 10
